subject: Private environment onboarding — phased surge plan & term alignment
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Victor Cruz <victor.cruz@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private environment onboarding — phased surge plan & term alignment

Hi Elena / Victor,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our conversation, Clearwave is planning to expand the private deployment footprint to support two new regional processing clusters (west-us and us-central) at the next renewal. You mentioned the need for a short-term burst buffer during the analytics migration window and aligning the contract term to coincide with your fiscal year Q1.

Attached: SOW_Clearwave_v2.pdf (draft SOW), capacity_burst_plan.xlsx (initial sizing), priv_network_diagram.png (high-level).

High-level asks from our side so we can firm up pricing and schedule: 
- Confirm target go-live window for the west-us cluster and the planned migration week (we noted late Jan).
- Desired burst capacity (concurrent inference units) and maximum retention for KV cache during the migration.
- Whether Clearwave will require dedicated audit logging retention beyond standard package.

I'll loop in Ops for provisioning estimates; Marcus, can you confirm the timeline and whether we can deliver a controlled burst pool for 6 weeks?

Next steps: if we can lock those items this week, I'll circulate an amendment with term adjustment options for review.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private environment onboarding — phased surge plan & term alignment

Rachel — thanks for the summary and the files. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Timeline: target go-live for west-us cluster = week of 2027-01-24. Central cluster target follows 6 weeks later. We do need the west-us burst in place for three weeks starting on day 1 of the migration window.

2) Burst sizing: start with 300 concurrent inference units, with the option to scale to 450 for a maximum of 72 hours if migration spikes. The capacity_burst_plan.xlsx looks close; we'll confirm exact throughput numbers next week after we align with our data team.

3) Audit logs: we require 2 years retention for audit logs (HIPAA posture), and we will need SOC2 attestation evidence for the private control plane. Can you confirm how Redwood surfaces that?

Also — on the term: we'd prefer the contract amendment to push the renewal date to 2028-01-31 so the expanded env sits on our fiscal year. That will affect pro-rated charges for the new clusters.

Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Cloud Ops | Clearwave Health
elena.soto@clearwavehealth.com | +1 206-555-0789

Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private environment onboarding — phased surge plan & term alignment

Hi all — Ops note. We can set up a temporary burst pool that is isolated to Clearwave's private control plane. Implementation notes: 
- Pre-provision West-US cluster with reserved nodes for baseline 300 units; burst autoscale policy to 450 with a 72-hour max continuous limit.
- KV cache: we can provide prefix-anchored cache with 48-hour hot retention by default; we can extend to 7 days for the migration window but it will add ~12% to memory footprint.
- Audit logs: we can route audit events to your KMS-backed S3 bucket; retention policies we can set for 24 months as requested. SOC2 evidence: we will provide the SOC2 report and the relevant control mappings (see drive link).

Estimated provisioning lead time: 5 business days after final SOW sign-off (hardware scheduling dependent). Incremental monthly for the burst buffer (if maintained beyond 6 weeks) will be included in the amendment.

David — I added a provisional line-item for the burst in the costing worksheet. Can you take point on the amendment draft for term/pro-ration language?

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Marcus — that all sounds workable. A couple follow-ups: 
- Please confirm whether the burst pool will be charged at a sustained compute rate or an overage-style short-burst premium. We want to model worst-case costs if we hit 450 for more than 72 hours.
- On KV cache: the 7-day migration retention is important for us; please provide the delta cost estimate.
- SOC2 report: can you send the exact control IDs that map to audit logging and access revocation? We need those for our compliance package.

Victor and I will run the internal approval once we have the amendment language for term/proration and the updated cost line items.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena / Victor — attaching the amendment draft and updated SOW with pro-ration examples per your requested renewal date shift. Key excerpts: 

- Term alignment: amendment moves renewal to 2028-01-31; proration for added clusters calculated pro-rata from effective date (2027-01-24) through 2028-01-31.
- Burst pool billing: billed as a reserved buffer with monthly standby fee (30% of standard CU rate) plus overage at 1.8x the standard per-CU rate for any usage beyond the 72-hour sustained allowance. This protects both sides vs unexpected 10x spikes.
- KV cache extension: 7-day migration retention delta = +12% memory surcharge + one-time data-transfer setup fee (listed).

Attachments (stubs): SOW_Clearwave_v2.pdf (updated), Amendment_CW_v1.docx, capacity_burst_plan.xlsx (with pricing).

If these terms look good I can prepare the DocuSign packet. Please confirm which billing contact we should send the invoice to for the pro-rated first month.

David Kim

david.kim@redwoodinference.com
